wins: Managed to reach final goal states quickly with high reward accumulation (47.5) despite only one episode.
fails: No successful completion achieved across the single episode, yielding a 0% success rate.

key_outcomes.summary: High reward throughput but lack of successful episode completion and over-dependence on mentor intervention; requires better automation of critical decision points.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent stalled at pivot decision points leading to mentor escalation before final exploit.
